text: In the lab's metrics module, the error measure defined as mean squared error divided by the variance of the target, MSE/Var(y), is abbreviated ___.
explanation: metrics.py defines nmse = mean((y_true−y_pred)**2)/var(y_true) = MSE/Var. NRMSE is its square root. The NARMA-10 lab and appendix report this NMSE (Jaeger 2002 reference ≈ 0.004).
